name: discussion-conventions-diagnosis
description: Diagnose academic-writing conventions in the Discussion of an English psychology research paper. Checks the Achievement/Contribution statement (placement, type among 4 — method / results / impact / application), limitations writing, future-work conventions, citation density and function, and the use of 'happy words' / appropriate hedging.
author: UX Course Project - Discussion Group

clawhub.theory_basis: Glasman-Deal (2021) Science Research Writing Unit 4 (contribution types + limitations conventions)
